title: How Much Do ChatGPT Ads Cost in 2026? CPM, CPC, and What to Budget

facts.fact: ChatGPT launched ads on February 9, 2026.
The page states that ChatGPT ads cost $25–$60 per 1,000 impressions (CPM).
facts.quote: ChatGPT ads cost $25–$60 per 1,000 impressions (CPM), or about $3–$5 per click (CPC) for most eCommerce categories.

facts.fact: The page states that ChatGPT ads cost about $3–$5 per click (CPC) for most eCommerce categories.
facts.quote: ChatGPT ads cost $25–$60 per 1,000 impressions (CPM), or about $3–$5 per click (CPC) for most eCommerce categories.

facts.fact: The page says OpenAI recommends a starting CPC bid of $3–$5.
facts.quote: OpenAI recommends a $3–$5 starting CPC bid.

facts.fact: The page states that finance, legal and SaaS ad clicks run $8–$25 per click, which it describes as higher than eCommerce.
facts.quote: Finance, legal and SaaS run higher, at $8–$25 per click.

facts.fact: The page states that ChatGPT ads launched in February 2026 at a $60 CPM with a $200,000 minimum commitment.
facts.quote: ChatGPT ads launched in February 2026 at a $60 CPM with a $200,000 minimum commitment.

facts.fact: The page says self-serve Ads Manager opened on May 5, 2026, and that there is no minimum spend.
facts.quote: since self-serve Ads Manager opened on May 5, 2026, any business can start with a small daily budget.

facts.fact: The page says the launch minimum commitment was cut to $50,000 in April 2026.
The page reports a current CPM floor of $25–$30 in competitive categories.
The page lists a third-party comparison figure of about $39 CPM for LinkedIn.
The page lists a third-party comparison figure of $14–$20 CPM for Meta.
The page lists a typical eCommerce and retail CPC of $3–$6.
The page lists a typical travel and education CPC of $4–$8.
The page lists a typical SaaS and software CPC of $8–$18.
The page lists a typical finance CPC of $15–$25.
The page lists a typical legal services CPC of $12–$20.
The page states that ads run in 89 countries for Free and Go users as of October 2026.
facts.quote: As of October 2026, ads run in 89 countries for Free and Go users

facts.fact: The page states that more than 100,000 advertisers have run campaigns on ChatGPT.
facts.quote: more than 100,000 advertisers have run campaigns.

facts.fact: The page says ads show only to Free and Go users, while Pro and Enterprise users are ad-free.
facts.quote: Ads show only to Free and Go users, in a labeled "Sponsored" unit below the answer.

facts.fact: The page says the conversion bidding option has been available since June 2026 and oCPM has been generally available since September 16, 2026.
The page cites a third-party source saying OpenAI can spend up to twice a campaign's daily budget on a high-demand day.
facts.quote: OpenAI can spend up to twice your daily figure
